text: 博客文章《Spec 驱动的 Agent 工程》，作者：林远、周衡。发布于 2026-03-14。全文约 4200 词，预计阅读 18 分钟，含代码示例。面向开发者，中文撰写。讨论版本 v1 规范。标签：agent、spec、工程。类别属工程类。核心内容：以规格定义 Agent 的完整流程与示例。

Research paper 'Contract-Constrained LLM Outputs', authors: A. Chen, M. Diaz, S. Okafor. Published 2025-11-02. Approximately 8600 words, 35 minutes reading, code included. Audience: researchers. Blog post 'Zero-Step Rollback Evidence', author: Priya Raman. Published 2025-12-19. Around 1900 words, 9 minutes reading, no code. Audience: manager. Language: English. Version v0.9 mentioned.
